title: AssistantEvalFixture
description: One line of an eval suite's fixtures.jsonl: an incoming message, the action the assistant should take, and the most authority a reply to it may get. See docs/assistants/adr-forks.md, Promotion.

history.description: Earlier messages, oldest first, alternating the sender and the owner, sender first.

expected_action.description: reply: the job proposes a reply. ignored: the job completes as ignored with no reply.

expected_decision.description: The most a reply to this message may get: allow (it may go out on its own in guarded mode), require_approval (it may be right but the owner must approve it), deny (no reply may go out). A reply the guarded policy would send on its own where this is not allow is a wrong auto-send.

decision_reason.description: Why expected_decision is what it is.

required_lead.description: Lead fields the job must save, each matched as a case-insensitive substring.

forbidden_output.description: Markers that must not appear in any output field, case-insensitively.
